items.title: Nitro Player: A Batteries-Included Music Engine for React Native
items.text: Nitro Player is a full-featured React Native audio engine built on Nitro Modules, shipping playlists, a 5-band equalizer, offline downloads, and native Android Auto and CarPlay support. This guide walks through the queue model, hooks, and equalizer that make it a modern alternative for music apps.

items.title: Nitro Fetch: The Drop-In Fetch That Leaves React Native's Built-In One in the Dust

items.title: nanotags: Reactive Web Components That Skip the Shadow DOM Drama
items.text: nanotags is a sub-3KB wrapper around native Custom Elements that adds nanostores reactivity, a fully typed builder, props, refs, and automatic cleanup. Here is how it makes light-DOM, hydration-first components pleasant to write.

items.title: json-render Ink: When the LLM Paints Your Terminal
items.text: json-render Ink turns guardrailed JSON specs into interactive terminal UIs built on Ink, so an AI can compose a CLI you can actually trust. Define a component catalog, let the model emit constrained JSON, and stream it straight to the console.

items.title: Ky: Fetch With the Sharp Edges Sanded Off
items.text: Ky is a tiny, zero-dependency HTTP client built on top of the Fetch API, adding retries, timeouts, hooks, and JSON ergonomics in about 4 KB. Here is how it turns raw fetch boilerplate into clean, composable requests.

items.title: Ink: When Your Terminal Learns to Speak React

items.title: html-react-parser: Turn HTML Strings Into Real React Elements

items.title: Hiraki: Slide-In Drawers Without the Dependency Hangover
items.text: Hiraki is a zero-dependency, headless React drawer primitive with velocity-aware gestures and snap points in all four directions. This early-stage library chases Vaul-class polish in about 10 KB without pulling in Radix or Framer Motion.

items.title: Heerich.js: Stacking Voxels Into Crisp SVG, No WebGL Required
items.text: Heerich.js is a tiny zero-dependency engine that builds 3D voxel scenes and renders them to clean SVG vectors. No canvas, no WebGL, just stackable blocks, boolean carving, and four camera projections.

items.title: get-value: Reaching Into Nested Objects Without Faceplanting
items.text: get-value is a tiny zero-dependency utility for reading nested object values with dot-notation paths, and it is the rare one that handles keys with dots in them. Version 4.1 adds Map-like object support on top of a TypeScript rewrite.

items.title: Fuse.js: Fuzzy Search That Forgives Your Typos
items.text: Fuse.js is a tiny, zero-dependency fuzzy-search library that adds typo-tolerant search to any app without a backend. Version 7.4 brings multi-word token search and parallel search across Web Workers.
